findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'x-content-type-options' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to prevent MIME-type sniffing attacks.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'x-frame-options' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' to prevent clickjacking.

findings.title: Technology Version Disclosure via Server Header
findings.description: Server discloses technology information in the 'server' header.
findings.recommendation: Remove or sanitize the 'server' header to prevent technology fingerprinting.

findings.title: Sensitive Page May Be Cached
findings.description: Page at sensitive URL path does not have cache-control: no-store or private.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Cache-Control: no-store, private' to sensitive pages.

findings.title: WebDAV Methods Enabled
findings.description: WebDAV methods are enabled: COPY, LOCK, MKCOL, MOVE, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, SEARCH, UNLOCK. This increases attack surface.
findings.evidence: WebDAV methods: COPY, LOCK, MKCOL, MOVE, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, SEARCH, UNLOCK
findings.recommendation: Disable WebDAV unless required. Restrict access with authentication.
